business_problem: Nationwide Pet needed to turn thousands of pages of highly technical veterinary medical knowledge into clear, consumer-friendly content fast enough to meet demanding project timelines, so pet owners could get useful guidance through its pet health platform.
solution_summary: Nationwide used an in-house generative AI workflow to accelerate content creation for Nationwide Pet HealthZone®. Emily Tincher's team prompted a generative AI tool to produce first-draft summaries for 71 pet health conditions, then iterated with additional prompts to generate both short-form and longer descriptions in plain language. Veterinarian experts reviewed, corrected, and enhanced the drafts before publication, keeping humans in the approval loop rather than serving model output directly. The vetted content became part of Nationwide Pet HealthZone®, which combines that medical guidance with Nationwide Pet claims data from millions of pets to deliver personalized information about specific health risks. The source does not name a separate storage or orchestration product, but it does describe a production flow of expert knowledge ingestion, AI-assisted drafting, human validation, and delivery through a customer-facing platform.

solution_components.name: Generative AI tool
solution_components.role: It generated first-draft summaries and short- and long-form descriptions of pet health conditions from technical veterinary knowledge.

solution_components.name: Nationwide Pet HealthZone®

business_outcome: Nationwide dramatically accelerated medical content creation for Pet HealthZone, met critical timelines without lowering quality, and strengthened the customer experience with personalized pet health information.
